$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (sources-developer-overheid). Seeds developer-overheid-oss, the developer.overheid.nl OSS-register API at https://api.developer.overheid.nl/oss-register/v1, which opencatalogi's publiccode-developer-overheid-harvest flow reads. DORMANT (isEnabled false). It holds no key: configuration.authentication.apikey is a credentialRef placeholder naming the broker credential developer-overheid-oss (ADR-064), which CallService resolves through the app-side injection path (BrokeredCallService::hydrateInjectableCredentials, OpenRegister CredentialBrokerService::resolveInjectable) before the configuration's Twig renders, so the X-Api-Key header template carries the key and the CallLog redacts that header. A top-level credentialRef (the proxy path) would not work: generic-apikey is inject-only and the broker proxy refuses it. To go live: request a read-only key at https://apis.developer.overheid.nl/apis/key-aanvragen, store it as a credential named developer-overheid-oss with provider generic-apikey and openconnector in its allowed apps, then enable the source. For the register's test environment change location to https://api.don.apps.digilab.network/oss-register/v1 and use a key from that environment. See openspec/changes/sources-developer-overheid/design.md D1.
